extracted.intended_audience: merchants and mercantile bookkeepers (early‑modern Italian / Venetian merchants)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical standards and procedures for mercantile recordkeeping: how to keep inventories, memoriale/daybooks, giornale, quaderni and ledgers, record debts/credits, coinage, and safeguards against loss or fraud. Aimed at organizing a merchant's commercial papers and accounting workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete inventory of goods (beni mobili e immobili)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tenere in lo inventario tutte le facede fue el mercatlfc piccole e grandi: narrare tutto quello che è mobile e immobile, come lo si trova, luogo, nome, misure, quantità e valore.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List every kind of asset (mobile and immobile), with location and description; for movable goods include counts, measures, colours, and distinguishing marks (e.g., 'pelli, mantelli, rubini, diamanti' listed by table/individual items). Record also where goods are kept (magazine, house, ship). Avoid omissions because the inventory serves as primary proof and a source for future transactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a memoriale (daybook) as first, immediate record
rubrics_metrics.description: Il memoriale è il primo libro dove si scrive ogni facenda quando avviene (memoriale primo e secondo), da cui si riporterà poi nel giornale e libro principale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep a short usable memoriale for immediate daily entries; it serves as the working copy for later transcription. Keep memoriale ordered and never omit to register daily happenings, because it is the basis for the principal book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcription from memoriale into giornale/libro grande
rubrics_metrics.description: Trasferire regolarmente dal memoriale al giornale e poi al libro principale (libro grande) con ordine e diligenza: 'prima faremo il primo memoriale... poi il secondo... poi il giornale... poi il libro generale'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post entries in due course so the ledger remains up-to-date; make the transfer in a clear, consistent order so each memoriale entry can be traced to the ledger. Use the giornale as the formal daily journal and the libro grande as the summary/general ledger.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record debts and credits per person (uno a uno)
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrare i debitori e i creditori 'a uno a uno' con nome, cognome e quanti sono, indicando il debito o credito di ciascuno.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each counterpart record a separate line/partita showing amounts due or owed; avoid aggregating multiple persons under vague headings. This allows individual follow-up, legal proof, and correct reconciliation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify terms of sale and purchase (tipi di contratto/termini)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicare sempre il tipo di compravendita: a termine, a contado, parte a termine e parte a contado, a termine e a parte di merce, ecc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark the terms (a termine / a contado / miste) on each entry so obligations and due dates are clear. Distinguish different transactional modalities because they affect when payment or delivery is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering and ordering of papers and pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Assegna il numero alle carte e alle pagine ('il numero oc le carti...') per evitare manomissioni e facilitare il riferimento.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number leaves, papers and pages, and preserve their order. This deters fraud (insertion/deletion of pages) and makes locating original entries possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate books for different purposes (giornale, quaderno, libro ordini, banco, memoriae specifici)
rubrics_metrics.description: Usare diversi registri: giornale (giornale/memo giornaliero), quaderno, libro grande, librone per specifici affari e taccuini per monete o piccoli movimenti.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain specialized books (cash book, daybook, main ledger, smaller notebooks) rather than mixing all affairs in one. Use appropriate format (columns, margini, intestazioni) for each book to improve clarity and control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record coinage and cash in detail (contanti e monete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nel giornale/memoriale distinguere contanti e segnare molti dettagli: tipi di monete, valore veneto e conversioni, numeri e somme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count and register coin denominations and convert to common unit (e.g., 'modo venetiano'). Record coin type and quantity to avoid ambiguity and enable accurate cash reconciliation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication and evidentiary form ('fede autentica')
rubrics_metrics.description: Alcuni scritti (es.: firme o atti particolari) meritano 'fede autentica' e sono da trattare come prova autentica nei giudizi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where entries must serve as legal evidence, ensure proper attestations/signatures or formal authentication. Keep such authentic records in reserved books and note their provenance and witness where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep copies and duplicate records to guard against loss/fraud
rubrics_metrics.description: Fare copie, tenere memoriali e giornali duplicati e conservare estratti o quaderni separati per ridurre il rischio di frode o perdita.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep at least one working copy and one principal copy; separate storage and orderly transcription reduces the chance that a single tampered book can defraud the merchant. Use secondary books (memoriale, estratti) to verify the libro grande.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use columns, margins, headings and consistent layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizzare il giornale e quaderni 'con colonne, margine e la prima carta dentro potrai' e dare un ordine certo alle righe e colonne.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set up consistent columns (date, particulars, debit/credit, currency columns) and leave margins for notes/indices. Use a clear heading on each page and consistent placement of entries to facilitate reading and tracing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record shipping and transport details for goods (navi, galee, ritorni)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per merci mandate per nave o galea indicare le navi, le muta di dette galee e i ritorni: 'specificare la muta de ditte galie...'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When goods travel by sea, record the vessel, cargo particulars, and any expected returns or contingencies. This is necessary for claims, sharing of returns, and tracking consignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe goods with appropriate specificity (tipo, misura, colore, stato)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per tessuti, pelli, mantelli e altri beni indicare colore, misura, numero, qualità e altre note distintive ('narrare come li inuentano: panni, mantelli, lenzuoli, piume, ecc.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give enough detail to distinguish items (colour, size, pair, count), especially for small/high‑value items. For jewellery and pledges (anelli, rubini, diamanti) list individually and note if ligati/obbligati.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid careless page insertion or loose papers (prevent manipulations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Non mettere carte sciolte senza ordine nel giornale; evitare che carte vengano inserite o tolte a danno dell'ordine (pericolo di frode).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bind or otherwise secure papers; insertions or loose leaves allow fraudulent insertions. If additional papers are needed, record them in the index and cross‑reference so their provenance is clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain indices and alphabetical/subject lists (alfabeto, memoriale cronologico/alfabetico)
rubrics_metrics.description: Usare un alfabeto e memoriale crodtdoe/estratto per facilitare ricerca: 'alfabeto... libii crod... quaderno crod...'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep an index or alphabetical register of names and subjects so entries can be quickly located. Use an 'estratto' (extract) or memoriale alfabetico for names/partite.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily discipline: timely notation and regular checking
rubrics_metrics.description: Nota il maestro e chi risponde a tempo: 'nota el maestrino ebe respondano a tepo p tèmpo' — registrare e verificare regolarmente.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record transactions promptly and have accountable persons responsible for timely entries and checking. Regular review prevents accumulated errors and enables prompt action on overdue items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clearly record mixed or complex transactions (composizione di parti/merce/termini)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per compravendite composte (parte merce, parte denaro; parti a termine; rate) specificare la composizione e le condizioni ('parte nitta e parte robbe', 'parte a termine e parte contado').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When transactions have mixed consideration, spell out each component and its timing. Do not lump complex deals into a single vague entry; break them into sub‑entries if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make special notations for disputed or doubtful items
rubrics_metrics.description: Se qualche voce desta dubbio o è soggetta a contestazione, annotare il dubbio e tenerne traccia: 'ciò che fa dubbio... possono succedere dubbi'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag uncertain items in the book and keep supporting documents; avoid treating doubtful items as final until resolved. This preserves clarity in later disputes or audits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep separate registers for small/change items and household effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Tenere un taccuino o libretto per piccole mercanzie e le faccende di casa: 'un libbrioto/quaderno per le faccende piccole e grandi' e per effetti personali che valgono a comune stima.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use small pocket books for daily small transactions and a separate inventory for household effects so business records are not cluttered and personal items are traceable.
